structured_output.summary:
P0 hall: parts/room-1.mjs holds the designed hall (red runner carpet x7..8 z15..19, symmetric coat racks at x6/x9 z19, two hanging lanterns at (7,4,16) and (8,4,18)). On an unlocked copy of build.nbt it passes the room check: walk 28/28, min light 9, no dark cells, FIT OK.
In the real make.sh build it places nothing: runParts locks the air the shell carved inside the hall, so all 16 carpet writes are REFUSED and the coat racks and lanterns are skipped (0 placed). build.nbt is whole but has no hall furniture.
The fix is outside my module: runParts (or the shell's interior g.fill "air") must let later parts furnish carved air. This blocks every room part, not just this one.
left: The real build.nbt has no P0 hall furniture: runParts refuses writes into air that shell-west carved (fill "air" over the interior, parts/shell-west.mjs), and the lock covers air too. Needs a library or shell change: lock only non-air cells, or stop the shell writing air into room interiors (a fresh Grid is already air). Same blocker for every room part.

Verified only on /tmp/p8-check/test.nbt (build.nbt plus room-1's build applied with load() and no lock): walk OK, light min 9, FIT OK. Once the lock is lifted, re-run ./make.sh and the room check on the real build.nbt to confirm.

Helper gaps: coatRack and porchLantern write nothing when the cell is locked and return refused without a report line in the part's output, so the part shows 0 placed with no reason. Not my module; flagged for whoever owns vocab.
plan.md checklist and elements.md items not ticked: this part builds no bed, table or stove, and the room's elements in elements.md are not mine to tick until the lock is fixed.

waste.what: Found the lock problem only after a full make.sh run: the 16 refused carpet writes showed up in the part report, not in any earlier check, so I learned the air was locked by reading the make log rather than before writing.
waste.cost: One full make.sh run (about 1 minute) plus one diagnostic pass of build-library source to confirm that runParts locks air.
waste.tool: A pre-flight in runParts or mcd room that lists which cells of a room box an earlier part has locked, before the room part is written.

waste.what: Verified the design on an unlocked copy by writing a one-off script in /tmp that loads build.nbt and calls build(g) directly, because the real build refuses the writes.
waste.cost: One script, one save, one mcd room run; the copy is test-only and not the deliverable.
waste.tool: A build-library option such as runParts(..., { lock: 'non-air' }) or a dry-run flag that applies a part without the lock, so a designer can test furnishing on the real build.
